summary.text: Melissa Schmidt is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 141 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career includes nonprofit development and serving as a state-certified childcare center director.

paragraphs.text: Melissa Schmidt's career experience includes working in nonprofit development and program coordination, and serving as a state-certified childcare center director.
She took office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Hannah Kelly.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the Elementary and Secondary Education and Children and Families committees.
